title: Memory--Transport Competition in Physical Two-Bath Quantum Reset Dynamics
summary: Coherence preservation and environmental renewal offer competing ways of controlling quantum memory and transport. We show that a seemingly natural protocol which exactly replaces the bath occupations while preserving arbitrary system--bath coherences need not correspond to a physical fermionic state. We instead construct a two-reservoir protocol with independent, number-conserving thermal attenuators, for which complete positivity and fermionic admissibility hold by construction.
